items.raw_excerpt: The 32nd edition of CineEco, the Serra da Estrela International Environmental Film Festival, will feature 87 films from 34 countries in competition from 9 October to 17 October in Seia (Guarda district), the organisers announced.

items.raw_excerpt: Thanks in part to social media, the number of English-language books read in the Netherlands is increasing, and with it, the number of shops catering those bookworms. The NOS reports that over the past four years, at least ten new English-language bookstores have opened their doors in the country, including in Tilburg, Utrecht, and Amersfoort. items.raw_excerpt: Kanjikuzhi in Kerala has built a local vegetable-growing system that relies on kitchen gardens, backyards and pots rather than large farms. Reported by Scroll, the community’s chemical-free approach has reduced dependence on outside supply and offers a practical model of food self-reliance.The village’s experience also points to a wider economic lesson for India: resilience can be built through small, distributed efforts that lower exposure to price shocks and chemical inputs.
items.summary_en: A village called Kanjikuzhi in Kerala, India has built a local food system using kitchen gardens and backyard pots instead of large farms. Their chemical-free approach has reduced dependence on outside supply. The model shows how small, distributed efforts can build resilience against price shocks.
